text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
W-Well then... regarding the local 
arrangements... I humbly leave them in 
your capable hands...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me. For anything regarding 
expeditions, please feel free to consult 
the Expedition Support Committee."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"How did it go, Chrono-chan? Are the 
travel arrangements going smoothly?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It seems we will be able to use all 
the facilities we requested without any 
issue.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, I'm so jealous! I haven't even had 
any ideas come up for a place to go 
unwind...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The "Breeders' Cup" rotates host venues, 
after all... Gathering local information 
must be quite a challenge...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
So cool, so cool! An overseas expedition! 
I wanna go too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you... considering a trip to Hong 
Kong as well, Gran-san?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I can't really make up my mind. 
Between Hong Kong and the Mile 
Championship, that is.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Hey, how many miles would we rack up 
if we flew to France and America?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san. There were no issues with 
the arrangements made by the expedition 
committee.
choice_data_list:
Thank you. It's finally here, the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe!

Thank you. It's finally time, the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! To challenge the long-cherished 
dream of Japanese racing... it is truly an 
honor...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
With Loves-chan's Breeders' Cup... I hope 
the two of us can achieve a historic first 
together...

Chrono Genesis and her peers were 
mastering their respective paths, just as 
they had once promised each other.

Loves Only You won an international G1 in 
Hong Kong. This autumn, she will take on 
another long-held dream of Japanese 
racing: the Breeders' Cup.

After conquering two distance classes in 
mile and sprint races, Gran Alegria is now 
taking on medium-distance races, aiming 
for a triple-class conquest.

In the Tenno Sho (Spring), said to be 
tough for Tiara Umamusume, Curren 
Bouquetd'or showed incredible tenacity and 
left the crowd in awe.
And Chrono Genesis—

"She won the Takarazuka Kinen in the 
spring, becoming the first-ever Tiara 
Umamusume to achieve three consecutive 
Grand Prix victories!"

Our next goals are the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe, and a fourth consecutive Grand 
Prix victory at the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually... I've put together a 
brand-new file of materials on the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I've compiled past interviews and on-site 
report articles...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Using this as a reference, I'd like to... 
actually visit the places our seniors 
spent time at...
choice_data_list: You mean like a holy pilgrimage for fans?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... Since it's such a rare 
opportunity...!
choice_data_list: Can I come with you, too?
Can I come with you, too?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course...! Um... I've even checked 
out the restaurants where the 
upperclassmen dined...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... I'm so excited, France...
choice_data_list: I'm counting on you for French, okay...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, y-yes...! Hehe, it's my turn to back 
you up this time, isn't it...? I'll do my 
best...!

And time flew by in a flash... until the 
day of departure for the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe arrived.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
No... it's just, somehow... it feels like 
a dream... and a wave of emotion washed 
over me...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
To think that... I can cross over to the 
land of the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 
together with my Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...It's like... a miracle...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ever since that "Arima Kinen"... perhaps 
we have been weaving a miraculous drama 
all along...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're right. As long as we have 
this Genesis Factor... no one will ever be 
able to surpass us.
(—*rustle*)

—Just then, a letter dropped out of Chrono 
Genesis's bag. I pick it up and hand it 
back to her.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, excuse me... This was... given to me 
in front of the school gates this 
morning... By someone with a rather 
mannish vibe...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Um... it, it seems they're an avid reader 
of my column...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...S-Someday... I'd love to write... a 
column about my hoofprints...!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-It's a little embarrassing, but... I'm 
very happy...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Besides... I want to become an Umamusume 
who defines an era, too...
choice_data_list: I must have been influenced by you!

So you were the one who inspired them, 
huh!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Seeing my hoofprints... someone will 
follow in my wake, and a new era will be 
forged...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Have I become one of the Umamusume who 
makes history, too...?"
choice_data_list:
Yeah! You're an Umamusume who shines 
brightly in racing history!

Yeah! An Umamusume who shines brilliantly 
in racing history!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe. Well then... let us go and make 
history anew.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Conquering the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, 
and making history with 4 consecutive 
Grand Prix victories—!"
